create.name: Uma Girish
create.bio:
Uma Girish is a grief companion, spiritual mentor and author who lives in suburban Chicago. She grew up in southern India and moved to the United States with her husband and daughter in 2008; within weeks her mother was diagnosed with cancer and died eight months later. That loss broke open the questions of who she was and why she was here, and the search that followed became her work: walking with women through loss of every kind and helping them find what the loss is asking of their lives.

She works one to one, mostly online, as a mentor and a Human Design reader, offering life-purpose sessions and a twelve-session mentoring programme that uses a person's chart as a map for turning grief into purpose. She also runs a group programme on putting spiritual ideas such as surrender and inner guidance into practice, sells short recorded masterclasses on forgiveness, boundaries, listening and ego and soul, and gives local workshops near Chicago. Her books include the memoir Losing Amma, Finding Home, Lessons From Grace and Sacred Fire, a memoir of her marriage, and she hosts the podcast Being Fully Me. She is a co-founder of the International Grief Council.

books.title: Sacred Fire: Memoir of A Marriage
books.author: Uma Girish
books.description: Her fourth book, a memoir of how her spiritual awakening led her and her husband to a crossroads, and how two people who love each other can walk different soul paths together.

books.title: Lessons From Grace: What A Baby Taught Me About Living and Loving
books.author: Uma Girish
books.description: Short reflections drawn from time with a baby, Grace, on trust, presence and finding the way back to who we were before the world shaped us.

books.title: Losing Amma, Finding Home: A Memoir About Love, Loss and Life's Detours
books.author: Uma Girish
books.description: Her Hay House memoir of losing her mother months after moving from India to Chicago, and of the spiritual turn and new calling that followed.

books.title: Understanding Death: 10 Ways to Inner Peace for the Grieving
books.author: Uma Girish
books.description: A short guide for people in grief, setting out ten ways to find some peace while living with a death.

courses.title: Purpose by Design Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one Human Design readings in which she reads a person's chart for their strengths, gifts and the kind of work and life that suits them, over two or three hour-long sessions.

courses.title: Finding Purpose Through Pain
courses.description: Twelve one-to-one mentoring sessions for women who have come through a loss and want to live with more meaning, using the Human Design chart as a map for their purpose and the lessons of their grief.

courses.title: Spirituality in Practice
courses.description: A seven-week group programme for people who know spiritual ideas such as surrender, intuition and letting go, and want to practise them in daily life. Currently taking names for a waitlist.

courses.title: How the Heck Do I Surrender? Masterclass
courses.description: A recorded masterclass on why control feels safe, the demands of the spiritual ego and practical ways to let go and invite the Divine in.

courses.title: The Dilemma of Living as a Divine Human
courses.description: A thirty-minute recorded teaching with a grounding meditation and reflection prompts on honouring both personality and soul and avoiding spiritual bypassing.

courses.title: Your Identity: Ego vs. Soul
courses.description: A 37-minute recorded teaching with an opening meditation and reflection prompts on letting the ego serve the soul.
